name: Cá khô kho rim
summary: Cá khô kho rim is dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it, fragrant like the other dried seafood, and eaten with rice.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried seafood on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: Simmer the dried fish. The same study lists grilled dried fish as the other way to cook it.
With rice at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets.
seoTitle: Cá khô kho rim — dried fish simmered, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it, fragrant, in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp.
